lines.text: Many learners say: I am interesting in music.
Better: I am interested in music.
I feel interested. Music is interesting.
Interested! I am interested in history.

data.why: I feel interested. Music is interesting.

native.tip: 说人的感受用 interested，interesting 描述事物。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am interesting in music.”？😅 人感兴趣用 interested，事物有趣才用 interesting：“I am interested in music.”。跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“interested”。人感兴趣用 interested！免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: For how you feel, use interested. Interesting describes the thing.
en.caption: Do you say “I am interesting in music.”? 😅 For your own feeling use interested; interesting describes the thing: “I am interested in music.”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
